title: every Page has a face, even without a photo

criteria.text: The photo step is optional; the composer completes without one
criteria.note: `PagePhotoPicker` sits in the About step of `SellWalkthrough` (`isOptional`) and in `PageEditor`; `photoUrl: null` clears, a failed upload does not trap the member [V src]. Built by #121: no `Reviewed by:` line [V]; no deploy-health run for 61902755 [V]. Checked no: unmarked `PagePhotoPicker.test.tsx` ('never blocks the step'), `SellWalkthrough.test.tsx`; zero `[guards F070.n]` markers in src or tests [V grep]. Smoked unknown: the composer is not a smoke route. Open #598.

criteria.text: Stored bytes carry no metadata, GPS included, verified against the file
criteria.note: `upload-image.ts` re-encodes through canvas to WebP; the `media` bucket accepts `image/webp` only (`039_media_bucket.sql`) [V]. Checked no: `upload-image.test.ts:112` reads a GPS fixture byte-level but on pipeline output, not an object read back from the bucket; unmarked [V]. Built by T120 and #121, both before deploy-health ran, and neither carries `Reviewed by:` [V]. Open #598.

criteria.text: A raw upload that bypasses the client is rejected by the storage API
criteria.note: Bucket `allowed_mime_types` webp, 5MB limit, insert/update/delete scoped to the member's own folder [V migration 039]. `tests/media-bucket-storage-api.test.ts` rejects JPEG, SVG, over 5MB and another member's prefix against a real stack; CI runs the Vitest suite against local Supabase [V ci.yml]. Checked no only because it carries no `[guards F070.3]` marker. Open #598.

criteria.text: A Page with no photo shows its kind's default image, the same for every viewer; a missing Page picture falls back to it
criteria.note: `DefaultArt` by kind (shop, service, group) on the Page (`ShopPublicPage`), the browse card (`BrowseResultCard`, now photo-led, #931) and the post card, with the Page-picture-then-placeholder fallback in `PagePosts` (marked F099.6) [V]. Since #969 (change #335, 2026-10-19) the signed-out withheld card gets the kind too: `announcements_withheld` returns `kind` and `mapWithheldRow` passes it as `groupKind`, so a no-photo or hidden-photo card draws the kind's art rather than a plain tile, the same for every anonymous reader [V src/lib/feed/withheld-announcements.ts, WithheldAnnouncementCard.tsx]. Checked no: `[guards F093.4]` in `tests/f093-withheld-card-criteria.test.tsx` asserts the withheld card's kind (red before the migration, #969 body); `DefaultArt.test.tsx` and the Page and card tests are unmarked; nothing marks F070.4 (#598). Reviewed no: #312 and #364 carry no `Reviewed by:`; #969 has `Reviewed by: Claude (Explore lane)` [V]. Shipped: deploy-health green on 19e90a05, c006495f, bfbbd619 [V]. Smoked: smoke-live run 39977671049 on main cb892a75 (2026-10-23) was green and opened explore and page at 390 and 1280 signed out and as members; it loads the route, it does not tap [V]. #335 closed 2026-10-19.

criteria.text: The operator removes a Page's photo in one action
criteria.note: Overtaken by the 2026-09-17 ruling in scenario F058: a moderation decision is a reversible event and removal sets `photo_removed_at` instead of deleting, so one action cannot also delete the bytes. Removal shows in the admin queue as built [V]. Shown, not counted.

criteria.text: The photo's stored object is deleted and an event is recorded
criteria.note: Purge is the deliberate second act after removal: `report.purge_target` then `report.purge` delete the object (operator's own session, bucket delete policy `20261007250000_photo_purge.sql`) and write a `photo_purges` row with who, why and the path; a photo held under the F102 child-safety hold is refused [V src/actions/report/purge.ts]. Built by #508 (#491): `review-skipped`; deploy-health success on 89bc02ca [V]. Checked no: `purge.test.ts` covers the handlers, unmarked, and nothing deletes a real object. Smoked: run 39805278303 (2026-10-22) opened admin-reports as the operator, green; it loads the queue, it does not purge [V]. Open #842.
